name: Fight for Warsong Gulch
summary: A call to fight for Warsong Gulch helps preserve Ashenvale's natural defenses. Your efforts keep them intact for another day.

sections.title: Ashenvale's Defenses
sections.body: In Ashenvale, you are asked to fight for Warsong Gulch. Your work helps keep the area's natural defenses intact for another day.
